title: Interop: cross-check mimid against Arkret coland's MIMI provider facade
description: Found in survey 2026-11-13 (mimid-1wgh.46.8). arkret-org/coland (Rust, Apache-2.0, reference Arkret Station server) has an experimental MIMI Provider Facade (profile ak.profile.mimi_interop.v1, spec arkret-org/arkret-spec spec/v1/zh/extensions/mimi-interop.md, Chinese) pinned to draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06, content-08, room-policy-03 and draft-kohbrok-mimi-identifiers-01. Routes in crates/http/src/routing/interop/mimi.rs: /.well-known/mimi-protocol-directory, provider-directory, key-material, strands/{id}/update|notify|messages, consent/request|update, identifiers/query, proxy-download. Client side in arkret-org/arkret-rust-sdk (crates/http-client/src/endpoints/mimi.rs, mimi_directory.rs). Conformance fixtures in arkret-spec spec/v1/artifacts/fixtures/mimi-*.json. Very active (commits daily). Pinned revisions lag mimid (protocol-07, content-10): start with directory + keyMaterial shape against their fixtures; decide whether a live run is worth it. No public deployment found; not seen on the mimi list or the 127 side-meeting thread.
